evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton commits the group to a recurring obligation by unilateral declaration, then enacts rank by defining what counts as possession for everyone — the rehearsed/unrehearsed dichotomy is a proportionality frame but the speech act is command.

mints.name: MandateByAxiom
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being claimed by declaring a self-evident rule that binds everyone, rather than by invoking rank directly?
